result.title: Xtream: An Explicit Metric State for Large-Scale Streaming Reconstruction
result.summary: 3D foundation models (3DFMs) enable dense reconstruction in a feed-forward pass, yet their effective span is limited by cross-view attention. Local consistency has been expanded through geometric alignment of video chunks and recursive updates of an implicit memory, and large-scale scenes with pose graphs. However, both strategies are prone to drift, largely due to the lack of metric-scale observability from monocular geometry. We present Xtream,a hybrid streaming pipeline that maintains an explicit metric state through a factor graph over keyframes, while using a 3DFM as a geometric front end. Xtream incorporates metric information in two ways: through metric scale predictions from 3DFMs; or through inertial measurements if available. Across the large-scale benchmarks of VBR, Oxford Spires and KITTI, Xtream achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3DFM-based online reconstruction, reducing average absolute trajectory errors compared with published baselines and concurrent work. https://ernestolozano.github.io/xtream

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Xtream，一个混合流式重建管线：以关键帧上的因子图维护显式度量状态，3D 基础模型仅作几何前端，并借助度量尺度预测或惯性测量补足单目几何缺失的尺度可观测性以抑制漂移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显式状态＋因子图」与递归隐式记忆的对比，可能为 LVR 中长跨度推理状态的显式维护、漂移与状态更新提供概念参照；但该工作面向三维重建而非 VLM 推理，联系需较多核查。
